class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Gemini in Google Messages</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div><p>You can chat with Gemini in the Google Messages app to draft messages, brainstorm ideas, plan events, or simply have a fun conversation.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li><a id="device" name="device"></a>An Android phone.</li>
  <li>Your phone’s language set to a <a href="#languages" rel="noopener">supported language</a>.</li>
  <li>The latest version of Google Messages <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6">. <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.messaging" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Get it on Google Play</a>.</li>
  <li>A personal Google Account that you manage on your own.
    <ul>
      <li>You can’t use Gemini in Google Messages with a Google Account managed by Family Link or with a Google Workspace account.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Be 18 or over.</li>
  <li>RCS chats turned on. <a href="/messages/answer/7189714" rel="noopener">Learn how to turn on RCS chats</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="languages" name="languages">Supported languages for Gemini in Google Messages</a>

<div>

<a class="zippy" id="countries" name="countries">Countries where Gemini in Google Messages is available</a>

<div>
  <div><p>Gemini in Messages is currently available in over 165 countries. We’re working hard to release it to users in more languages and more places around the world.</p>
</div>

        <li>United States Minor Outlying Islands</li>
        <li>Uruguay</li>
        <li>Uzbekistan</li>
        <li>Vanuatu</li>
        <li>Venezuela</li>
        <li>Vietnam</li>
        <li>Western Sahara</li>
        <li>Yemen</li>
        <li>Zambia</li>
        <li>Zimbabwe</li>
      </ul>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="chat">Start a chat with Gemini in Google Messages</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Chats with Gemini aren’t end-to-end encrypted.</p>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your Android phone, open Google Messages <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6">.</li>
  <li>Tap the chat with Gemini, or tap <strong>Start chat</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Gemini</strong>.</li>
  <li>For the first time, follow any on-screen instructions.</li>
  <li>Enter your question or prompt.
    <ul>
      <li>The first time you chat with Gemini, you can explore different conversations. Just tap a suggestion above the message field.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Optionally, to add a photo to your prompt, tap Show attach media screen <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YMcf50CEn3XZlkSNKXGTa2-2UVgfB1V4dFIYYEm-79k5A5erkxwqBnMW1KkP02ANdg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YMcf50CEn3XZlkSNKXGTa2-2UVgfB1V4dFIYYEm-79k5A5erkxwqBnMW1KkP02ANdg">.</li>
  <li>Tap Send message <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/s-37MwMxo7cArIBoPUKLR-Z-ILQWKC4IO0sUyO-aQ9oLAA5g3Ia74yuIgreYQzTSiA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/s-37MwMxo7cArIBoPUKLR-Z-ILQWKC4IO0sUyO-aQ9oLAA5g3Ia74yuIgreYQzTSiA">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also use apps in your chat with Gemini in Google Messages. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn more about using apps with Gemini</a> and <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044?co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid#turn_on_off" rel="noopener">how to manage apps in Gemini</a>.</p>

<h3 id="examples">Examples</h3>

<div><ul>
  <li>I haven't reached out to my friend in a while. Help me draft a short message to check in and reconnect.</li>
  <li>Suggest a 3-course dinner menu that's impressive but manageable for a novice cook. Dietary restriction: vegetarian.</li>
  <li>I'm going to a social event where I barely know anyone. Come up with a few interesting conversation starters.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="feedback">Give feedback on a Gemini response</h2>

<div><ol>
  <li>Touch and hold the response you want to give feedback on.</li>
  <li>At the top, tap Good response <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/CG9rwluducvu91WI0uzGFTzm1EwaZEZgxPua1cIGAvvh0-G-Y1dHZzr6oZhn2QlO79bW=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/CG9rwluducvu91WI0uzGFTzm1EwaZEZgxPua1cIGAvvh0-G-Y1dHZzr6oZhn2QlO79bW"> or Bad response <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/_DLwtJB8hM9uNlcBMzq6e1L1XGwgOMDR5y333rh9ohBxO-dU6SCgKQl-lvVa8ttlkbU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/_DLwtJB8hM9uNlcBMzq6e1L1XGwgOMDR5y333rh9ohBxO-dU6SCgKQl-lvVa8ttlkbU">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="legal">Report a legal issue</h2>

<div><ol>
  <li>Touch and hold a response.</li>
  <li>Tap More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Report legal issue</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://support.google.com/legal/troubleshooter/1114905?#ts=1115658%2C13380504" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Report legal issue</a></div>

<h2>Disable Gemini in Google Messages</h2>

<div><ol>
  <li>Open Google Messages&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6">.</li>
  <li>At the top, tap your <strong>profile picture</strong> or <strong>initials</strong>&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong>&nbsp;Messages settings</strong>&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"><strong>&nbsp;Gemini in Messages</strong>.</li>
  <li>Turn off&nbsp;<strong>Show Gemini button</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="delete_conversation">Delete your Gemini chat</h2>

<div><p><strong>Important:</strong> In Google Messages, you can only delete your entire Gemini chat. In your <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>, you can delete specific prompts from your Gemini chat.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="delete_gm" name="delete_gm">In Google Messages</a>

<div>
  <div><p>After you complete the steps below, your Gemini chat is deleted from your <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a> and Google Messages.</p>
</div>

  <div><ol>
  <li>In Messages, open your chat with Gemini.</li>
  <li>At the top, tap More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Delete conversation</strong>.</li>
  <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="delete_gaa" name="delete_gaa">In Gemini Apps Activity</a>

<div>
  <div><p>After you complete the steps below, your Gemini chat is deleted from your Gemini Apps Activity. It doesn't delete the chat from Google Messages or any Android backup of your messages. To also delete it from Google Messages, follow the <a href="#delete_gm" rel="noopener">steps to delete the chat from Google Messages</a>.</p>
</div>

  <div><ol>
  <li>Go to your&nbsp;<a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>.</li>
  <li>Next to a prompt or response in Google Messages, tap Delete activity item <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/D_3DIOWCQFoPi3gLkIMCUgQB4VuBoAwajnw6wOA06s1VNoYIjbmH_pocLcIzQ1go7A=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/D_3DIOWCQFoPi3gLkIMCUgQB4VuBoAwajnw6wOA06s1VNoYIjbmH_pocLcIzQ1go7A">.
    <ul>
      <li>Activity from Google Messages shows a “<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/EV9Hcm2Ui1njr1EXpvtjlNeg6ANOB_lEu4170SRQvZXYW624XgZXj4wtHcfPdb-cAyR6"> Google Messages” label.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
</ol>
</div>

  <p><strong>Tip:</strong> To access your Gemini Apps activity from the Gemini web app, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>. Then at the top, tap Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/WV_ISq--uyr-MIPIpt0fKwaunhBJ0nW5BbRSxzyr_xmIaZyVVjrxk1071tEmJBW-E2sz=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/WV_ISq--uyr-MIPIpt0fKwaunhBJ0nW5BbRSxzyr_xmIaZyVVjrxk1071tEmJBW-E2sz"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Activity</strong>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="about_deleting_conversations">What happens when you delete your Gemini chats</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>When you delete your Gemini chat in Google Messages or in your <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>, Gemini can no longer access the chat.</li>
  <li>When you delete your Gemini chat in Google Messages, it’s also deleted from your <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>.
    <ul>
      <li>If the chat still shows in your Gemini Apps Activity or Google Messages on other devices, check the device you used to delete the chat. Make sure it’s connected to the internet and RCS chats are turned on. <a href="/messages/answer/7189714" rel="noopener">Learn how to turn on RCS chats</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>When you delete your Gemini chat in your <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>, it doesn't delete it from Google Messages or any Android backup.
    <ul>
      <li>To also delete it from Google Messages, follow the <a href="#delete_gm" rel="noopener">steps to delete the chat from Google Messages</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="location_data">Learn about your location data &amp; Gemini in Google Messages</h2>

<div><p>Gemini in Messages doesn’t have access to your precise location. It uses the general area from your IP address or the <a href="https://myaccount.google.com/address/home" rel="noopener" target="_blank">home</a> or <a href="https://myaccount.google.com/address/work" rel="noopener" target="_blank">work</a> addresses in your Google Account to give relevant responses to prompts like “What’s the weather?” <a href="/websearch/answer/179386#home_work_location&amp;ip_location" rel="noopener">Learn more about how Gemini in Messages estimates your general area.</a></p>
</div>
